name: @wui-js/views
author: Sergio E. Belmar V. <wuijs.project@gmail.com>
description: WUI/JS Views Lib - Open-source JavaScript/CSS library of composite views (messages, progress, data listings) built from WUI/JS Main Lib classes.

scripts.prepare: test -d .git && exit 0 || (rm -f README.md && cp NPM.md README.md && cp -r src/wui-js/views/. .)
scripts.prepack: rm README.md && cp NPM.md README.md && cp -r src/wui-js/views/. .
scripts.postpack: rm -f README.md && ln -s docs/README-en.md README.md && ls src/wui-js/views/ | grep -vE '^LICENSE$' | xargs rm -rf
